positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
1. Designed and developed a logging system using Java and Proto2 (Protocol Buffer Language) within Android Studio to track cancelation origins within the Play Store to improve insights for billions of users that utilize the platform on a daily basis.
2. Designed and developed an improved uninstallation system within the large Play Store Installer infrastructure that is scalable, malleable, and generic enough while maintaining performance and system health.
3. Participated in the team’s FixIt week, fixing 16 bugs through 15 changelists and placing 8th overall across all participating Play Store teams.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
1. Taught weekly recitations and held weekly office hours to reinforce programming concepts in Java.
2. Created, graded, and provided feedback on exams and weekly homework assignments for the students.
3. Developed autograder programs to facilitate homework grading for approximately 500 students.
4. Conducted interviews for potential teaching assistant candidates.

company.name: College of Computing at Georgia Tech

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
1. Designed and developed an internal web-based data analytics tool for the DevOps Guru product using TypeScript, Python, HTML, CSS, and Vue.js to provide the team with metrics regarding the product’s accuracy and efficiency.
2. Learned and utilized 20+ Amazon Web Services products including S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, IAM, Cloud Development Kit (CDK), OpenSearch, EC2, VPC, and Step Functions.
3. Contributed over 9,000 lines of code across 20 repositories, expanding data coverage by supporting the backend and frontend of 2 new data sources.

company.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description:
1. Designed and developed an internal monitoring dashboard using Java, Proto3 (Protocol Buffer Language), GoogleSQL, Google Data Studio, and Google’s logging frameworks to measure the team’s product launch success and highlight any potential bugs.
2. Created dynamic user interfaces with accessibility support using Java and XML within Android Studio for millions of users under and over the age of consent as part of Google’s new improved privacy experience for personalized ads.
3. Used Espresso, JUnit4, Mockito, and Roboelectric (Android Testing Framework) to develop comprehensive unit tests, end-to-end integration tests, and test utility classes for multiple user interfaces, services, and client APIs maintained by the team.

projects.title: EGHI/GT Hack COVID-19 Project: DoctorDB
projects.description:
Creation of a 48-hour team project to find an innovative solution to a medical aspect of the Coronavirus crisis.

1. Used HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Google Charts API, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, and Python within Django to build a Web application that aims to build a COVID-19 case database with graphical analysis for effective treatments.
2. Worked mostly on the frontend, including graphical visualization of the data.

projects.title: Versus Virus Online Hackathon Project
projects.description: Creation of a 48-hour team project to find an innovative solution to a medical aspect of the Coronavirus crisis. Used Java, XML, Google Firebase, and Google Cloud Platform within Android Studio to build an AndroidX application that aims to build a COVID-19 case database with statistical analysis for effective treatments. Worked on both frontend and backend, including graphical and statistical implementation through the MPAndroidChart library.
